input.domain: Three explicitly present decoded valid UTF-8 Text values and allowed_header_name Text, each0..1024 UTF-8 bytes. Exact signed64 integers and exact Booleans; all12 record fields required. Semantic refusals (including empty/invalid headers, negative counts and MaxInt64 revisions) remain in-domain.
input.external_schema: Exactly one JSON object with exactly name,value,declared_length,facts. Facts has exactly the12 declared unique fields. Raw bytes<=32768. Malformed/trailing JSON, invalid UTF-8, lone surrogate escapes, decoded duplicate/extra/missing/null/wrong-type fields, fractional/exponent/out-of-int64 integers and oversized decoded Text refuse before Gooo.

semantics.candidate_name: Unchanged decoded candidate name; no normalization or lowercasing.
semantics.candidate_value: Unchanged decoded candidate value; no trimming or sanitization.
semantics.status: INVALID_INPUT for invalid candidate count/revisions or unsupported route field; REFUSED for a later failed guard; ELIGIBLE only if all guards pass.
semantics.reason: First matching reason from refusal_order; successful reason ROUTE_DIAGNOSTIC_FIELD_AND_PAYLOAD_ACCEPTED.
semantics.payload_eligible: Eligibility of the imported payload report, computed even when an earlier header-context guard wins.
semantics.payload_reason: Imported payload report reason; independent Go reference uses actual strconv.ParseInt(text,10,64).
semantics.header_name_valid: Pinned httpguts.ValidHeaderFieldName within bounded Text domain; empty is false.
semantics.header_value_valid: Pinned httpguts.ValidHeaderFieldValue within bounded Text domain; empty is true.
semantics.name_invalid_offset: First invalid UTF-8 byte offset, or -1; empty invalid name retains -1.
semantics.value_invalid_offset: First invalid UTF-8 byte offset, or -1.
semantics.value_has_obs_text: Any original decoded byte>=128, including after an earlier invalid byte.
semantics.value_edge_whitespace: Nonempty value starts or ends with SP or HTAB, even after an earlier invalid byte.
semantics.request_revision: Exact observed_request_revision input, including negative/extreme values; it is not a signed or authenticated identity.
semantics.eligible: Exactly status==ELIGIBLE; a pure plan, not an applied header change.

policy.expected_and_observed_revision_domain: 1..9223372036854775806 inclusive; a value of9223372036854775807 is an INVALID_INPUT refusal, never an eligible increment

input_population.interpretation: The preserved SPECIFICATION_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTED marker describes these four-field specifications. It is not a current verification status. Public verifier computes all16 fields freshly, checks these assertions, and separately requires native execution/saved replay.

scope: Pure automatic deterministic decision; no per-case human approval and no effects.
Trusted host must supply current observations from one request/body/principal/route/policy snapshot. Parsing claims does not authenticate them.

Host application requires an atomic compare of current request revision, authority/policy and field absence, followed by exactly one insertion and revision advance. This composition implements none of those effects.

Only an additive diagnostic field; no removal/replacement/coalescing, HTTP parsing/framing, streaming-body buffering, HTTP2 support, sending, authentication, UUID/uniqueness guarantee or production-safety claim.
No arbitrary-byte or arbitrary-length Go compatibility. Finite50 witnesses do not exhaust all inputs or contexts.
Fresh public source/case/producer/typed16-field checks and saved replay are required. Prior private PASS output is not current acceptance.
Independent typed inner canonical parent digest acceptance remains NOT_CHECKED.
